svg.title: Centred on the step edge at row 3, column 3, the Sobel X kernel's nine products sum to 515 — a large response, because the neighbourhood changes from dark to bright across it.
svg.desc: A seven-by-seven grid of grey values with a three-by-three window outlined on the cell at row 3, column 3. Beside it, the Sobel X kernel and the nine products of overlapping pixel and weight, written out and summed. The left column of the window holds values of 10 and the right column holds values of 200, so the negative left weights and the positive right weights do not cancel and the sum is 515. Away from the edge, where all nine neighbours are equal, the same kernel sums to zero.
